fix_specification_reasoning.diagnosis_and_repair_directions: The flawed specification incorrectly compares the query indices directly (query1 and query2) instead of using these indices to access the positions of the people in the order array. Intended Behavior:
The function is intended to process a series of queries about the positions of people standing in a line. For each query, given two positions A_i and B_i, the function should determine which person is standing closer to the front of the line and print the corresponding person number. The positions are based on a zero-indexed array derived from the input order of people.

Diagnosis and Repair Directions:
The flawed specification incorrectly compares the query indices directly (query1 and query2) instead of using these indices to access the positions of the people in the order array. The correct approach is to compare the indices of the people in the order array to determine who is closer to the front. Specifically, the function should compare the values at the indices `order[A_i - 1]` and `order[B_i - 1]` and print the person number corresponding to the smaller index value.
